lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The quarry is cold, flooded in places, and absent from modern logistics maps.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Old repair gantry, one intact generator, no fuel reserve.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Which makes it the best base we currently own.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Hideout. Not a base. Not yet.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Armor damage is persistent now. Every repair spends supplies we cannot replace.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Government search patterns will reach this district eventually.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Two contacts are transmitting: Ferris with a supply convoy, Saldaña with surviving witnesses.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: We need parts and we need the people who can prove Hollowmere. We cannot reach both at once.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Whichever operation we delay will get harder.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then we choose knowing the cost.

lines.speaker: ferris
lines.text: I can get you plating, fuel, and one reactor core. Do not ask where the manifest went.

lines.speaker: saldana
lines.text: I have two transports of witnesses moving without lights. The government is searching every road.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: We make this place functional and bring them home.
